name: Reference-frame reasoning
when: A direction or pose is ambiguous between image, camera and world coordinates.
preconditions: The task provides coordinate conventions or reference-view information.
procedure: Identify the reference frame of the observation and the frame expected by the action.
Use supplied camera information or visible landmarks to relate directions before editing.
If the mapping remains ambiguous, inspect permitted evidence before committing to a pose change.
verification: Check that the resulting visual direction agrees with the intended change.
failure_lessons: Do not equate screen-left with a fixed world-axis direction.
adaptation_notes: Adapts Spatial Localization & Relation to scene-operation decisions; no perception-tool names copied.
